task.title: P6-119: Fix partially-filled pull lines marked as fully pulled
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-119. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**A partially-filled pull line is struck through as "pulled" and its residual silently drops out of the walk** (was `P6-049b`). `needs.rs:793` sets `moved = !outcome.pulled.is_empty()`, so a line whose source lost copies between snapshot and tick is marked done even when fewer copies than the label moved. The user believes they pulled copies they did not.
